quaternion, angular velocity, frame_id, covariance/status, header stamp and sensor-to-base extrinsic version
timestamped map/base/sensor transforms and exact anchor lookup outcome
four 20×20 height/mask frames, native resolution/axis/unknown representation and frame header stamps
pre-Path goal identity, base-frame transform and stamp
8×2 base waypoints, map Path identity/SHA, publication stamp and geometry/profile/coverage hashes

synchronization: one pre-Path anchor with raw header and receipt stamps; preserve original clock domain and report nearest-sample ages, jumps and resets
invalidity: missing, stale, covariance sentinel -1, unknown extrinsic, unverified flipper calibration or non-stowed arm -> explicit mask/abstain, not zero fill
selection_and_storage: capture enough independent source trajectories and terrain/goal settings; retain raw messages and SHA, plus derived fixture output in a separate versioned root
